## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refresh helper should preserve existing fingerprints because overwriting them prevents verification from detecting hand-edited tracked files.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register previously unlisted files, with tests for registration and preservation behavior. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — When you include a hand-edited `tracked.txt` in `names`, refresh replaces its original digest, causing `verify()` to return `True`. This contradicts the PR description’s requirement that existing fingerprints detect hand edits. — Refreshing a hand-edited tracked file erases the baseline users need to detect that modification. — Fix: Apply the existing-entry guard from `register_new_files` and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries` with an edited tracked file.
